reasoning: The baseline Random Forest (cv=0.695) suffers from high train/CV gap (0.179), indicating overfitting or insufficient regularization. The previous voting ensemble with Logistic Regression and Gradient Boosting achieved the best score (0.7058) but used a shallow GB model. To improve generalization, we will: 1) Test HistGradientBoosting with stronger L2 regularization and early stopping to combat overfitting compared to standard Gradient Boosting. 2) Introduce a Pipeline architecture to explicitly scale numeric features before feeding them to the ensemble models, addressing potential leakage from standard scalers applied post-encoding in previous attempts. 3) Refine the Random Forest configuration by increasing n_estimators and adjusting max_depth to balance bias/variance better than the previous run.
